name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior natural resource company headquartered in Reno, Nevada, focused on gold and silver exploration. The company operates a three-part model covering mineral royalty creation and acquisition, precious metals streaming, and an exploration project accelerator. Its primary asset is the Lapon Canyon Gold Project southeast of Yerington, Nevada, where it reported significant gold intercepts in 2025 and commenced an RC drill program in 2026.
